== Life ==

Born in {{ill|Shinano Province|ckb|پارێزگای شینانۆ|cs|Provincie Šinano|de|Provinz Shinano|eo|Provinco Ŝinano|es|Provincia de Shinano|fa|ولایت شینانو|fr|Province de Shinano|gl|Provincia de Shinano|hak|Shinano-koet|id|Provinsi Shinano|it|Shinano (provincia)|ja|信濃国|knc|Shinano Province|ko|시나노국|lt|Šinano žemė|ms|Wilayah Shinano|nl|Shinano (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Shinano|pt|Província de Shinano|ru|Синано (провинция)|simple|Shinano Province|sk|Šinano (provincia)|sr|Провинција Шинано|th|แคว้นชินาโนะ|tr|Shinano (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сінано|zh|信濃國|zh_min_nan|Sinano-kok|zh_yue|信濃國|qid=Q289250|lt=Shinano Province}}, Suwa District, Enchū was the son of Suwa Moritada. According to the {{ill|Kami Clan Genealogy|ja|神氏系図}}, he was a branch member of the {{ill|Suwa-taisha|abstract|Q218813|de|Suwa-Taisha|es|Suwa taisha|eu|Suwa taisha|fa|زیارتگاه بزرگ سووا|fr|Suwa-taisha|hu|Szuva templom|id|Kuil Suwa|it|Santuario di Suwa (Sohonsha)|ja|諏訪大社|ko|스와 대사|lt|Suvos maldykla|pl|Suwa Taisha|ru|Сува-тайся|simple|Suwa-taisha|tr|Suwa-taisha|zh|諏訪大社|qid=Q218813|lt=Suwa-taisha}} Upper Shrine family and inherited the position of {{ill|Jitō|az|Cito|br|Jito|ca|Jitō|es|Jitō|eu|Jitō|fa|جیتو (ژاپن)|ff|Jitō|fr|Jitō (intendant)|ja|地頭|ko|지토 (일본사)|mk|Џито|ru|Дзито|sr|Џито|uk|Дзіто|vi|Jitō|zh|地头|qid=Q1329805|lt=jitō}} for {{ill|Shinomiya-shō|ja|四宮荘|qid=Q136731801}} Funayama village in {{ill|Hanishina District, Nagano|ceb|Hanishina-gun|de|Hanishina-gun|fa|شهرستان هانیشینا، ناگانو|fi|Hanishinan piirikunta|fr|District de Hanishina|it|Distretto di Hanishina|ja|埴科郡|ko|하니시나군|pl|Powiat Hanishina|uk|Повіт Ханісіна|vi|Hanishina, Nagano|zh|埴科郡|qid=Q726661|lt=Hanishina District}}, leading to his alternate name, '''Kosaka Enchū'''. His holdings also included lands in {{ill|Etchū Province|ja|Etchū Province}}, Takagi Village, and the villages of Miyake-gō Jūniri and Akanoi in {{ill|Ōmi Province|ca|Província d'Ōmi|ckb|پارێزگای ئۆمی|cs|Provincie Ómi|de|Provinz Ōmi|es|Provincia de Ōmi|fa|ولایت اومی|fi|Ōmin provinssi|fr|Province d'Ōmi|gl|Provincia de Ōmi|hak|Ōmi-koet|id|Provinsi Ōmi|it|Ōmi|ja|近江国|ko|오미국|lt|Omio žemė|nl|Omi (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Ōmi|pt|Província de Ōmi|ru|Оми (провинция)|simple|Ōmi Province|sk|Ómi (provincia)|sr|Провинција Оми|tr|Ōmi (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Омі|vi|Tỉnh Ōmi|zh|近江國|zh_min_nan|Ômi-kok|zh_yue|近江國|qid=Q843882|lt=Ōmi Province}}. The Suwa clan served as {{ill|hikan|ja|被官|zh|被官|qid=Q11626601}} under the {{ill|Hōjō clan|ar|عشيرة هوجو|be|Ходзё (род)|ca|Clan Hōjō|de|Hōjō|eo|Hojo (klano)|es|Clan Hōjō|eu|Hojo klana|fa|خاندان هوجو|fi|Hōjō-klaani|fr|Clan Hōjō|hu|Hódzsó család|id|Klan Hōjō|it|Clan Hōjō|ja|北条氏|ko|호조씨|ms|Puak Hōjō|nl|Hojo|no|Hōjōklanen|pl|Hōjō (ród)|pt|Clã Hōjō|ru|Ходзё (род)|sr|Клан Хоџо (Камакура)|th|ตระกูลโฮโจ|tr|Hōjō boyu|uk|Рід Ходзьо|zh|北條氏|qid=Q834364|lt=Hōjō clan}}, and Enchū’s uncle Suwa Tokimitsu was also an official of the Kamakura shogunate, fostering Enchū’s upbringing and service in Kamakura.

After the fall of the Hōjō clan, Enchū traveled to Kyoto and, through the mediation of {{ill|Musō Soseki|ca|Musō Soseki|de|Musō Soseki|es|Musō Soseki|fa|موسو سوسه‌کی|fr|Musō Soseki|ja|夢窓疎石|ko|무소 소세키|nl|Musō Soseki|no|Musō Soseki|pl|Soseki Musō|ru|Мусо Сосэки|uk|Мусо Сосекі|vi|Mộng Song Sơ Thạch|zh|梦窗疏石|qid=Q384703|lt=Musō Soseki}}, entered the service of {{ill|Ashikaga Takauji|ar|أشيكاغا تاكا-أوجي|ca|Ashikaga Takauji|cs|Takaudži Ašikaga|de|Ashikaga Takauji|es|Ashikaga Takauji|eu|Ashikaga Takauji|fa|آشیکاگا تاکائوجی|fi|Ashikaga Takauji|fr|Ashikaga Takauji|hak|Ashikaga Takauji|he|אשיקאגה טאקאוג'י|hu|Asikaga Takaudzsi|id|Ashikaga Takauji|it|Ashikaga Takauji|ja|足利尊氏|ko|아시카가 다카우지|mr|अशिकागा तकाउजी|nl|Ashikaga Takauji|pl|Takauji Ashikaga|pt|Ashikaga Takauji|ru|Асикага Такаудзи|simple|Ashikaga Takauji|sr|Ашикага Такауџи|sv|Ashikaga Takauji|th|อาชิกางะ ทากาอูจิ|tr|Ashikaga Takauji|uk|Асікаґа Такаудзі|vi|Ashikaga Takauji|zh|足利尊氏|zh_min_nan|Asikaga Takauzi|zh_yue|足利尊氏|qid=Q297107|lt=Ashikaga Takauji}}. He rose through the Ranks from {{ill|Hyōjōshū|ca|Hyōjōshū|es|Hyōjōshū|fa|هیوجوشو|ja|評定衆|ko|효조슈|zh|評定眾|qid=Q11288036}} to protectorate administrator, eventually overseeing the construction of {{ill|Tenryū-ji|ja|天竜寺}}. He later became the administrator of {{ill|Sōroku|ja|僧録|zh|僧錄|qid=Q10889387}}, managing Zen-related issues. Enchū also contributed to the revival of the Suwa clan, whose main line had declined after the {{ill|Nakasendai Rebellion|fa|شورش ناکاسندای|fr|Rébellion Nakasendai|id|Pemberontakan Nakasendai|ja|中先代の乱|ko|나카센다이의 난|zh|中先代之亂|qid=Q10871756}}, and helped establish a system where warriors across Shinano participated in the annual Suwa Upper Shrine festival.

In {{ill|Enbun|de|Enbun|fa|انبون (دوره)|fr|Ère Enbun|ja|延文|ko|엔분|ru|Эмбун|simple|Enbun|sr|Енбун|sv|Enbun|tr|Enbun|zh|延文|qid=Q1145071|lt=Enbun}} 1 ({{ill|1356|ab|1356|af|1356|als|1356|am|1356 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1356|ar|1356|ary|1356|arz|1356|ast|1356|avk|1356|az|1356|azb|۱۳۵۶ (میلادی)|be|1356|be_x_old|1356|bg|1356|bn|১৩৫৬|bpy|মারি ১৩৫৬|br|1356|bs|1356.|ca|1356|cdo|1356 nièng|ceb|1356|ckb|١٣٥٦|crh|1356|cs|1356|cv|1356|cy|1356|da|1356|de|1356|diq|1356|el|1356|eml|1356|eo|1356|es|1356|et|1356|eu|1356|fa|۱۳۵۶ (میلادی)|fi|1356|fo|1356|fr|1356|fy|1356|ga|1356|gan|1356年|gcr|1356|gd|1356|gl|1356|he|1356|hi|१३५६|hr|1356.|ht|1356 (almanak jilyen)|hu|1356|hy|1356|id|1356|ilo|1356|io|1356|is|1356|it|1356|ja|1356年|jv|1356|ka|1356|kaa|1356|kk|1356 жыл|ko|1356년|la|1356|lb|1356|lij|1356|lmo|1356|lt|1356 m.|lv|1356. gads|mai|१३५६|map_bms|1356|mdf|1356|mg|1356|mhr|1356|mi|1356|min|1356|mk|1356|mr|इ.स. १३५६|mrj|1356 и|ms|1356|my|၁၃၅၆|mzn|۱۳۵۶|nap|1356|nds|1356|new|सन् १३५६|nl|1356|nn|1356|no|1356|nrm|1356|nso|1356|oc|1356|or|୧୩୫୬|os|1356-æм аз|pl|1356|pnb|1356|pt|1356|qu|1356|ro|1356|ru|1356 год|rue|1356|sa|१३५६|sah|1356|scn|1356|sd|1356ع|se|1356|sh|1356.|shn|1356|simple|1356|sk|1356|sl|1356|smn|1356|sq|1356|sr|1356|su|1356|sv|1356|sw|1356|tg|Соли 1356|th|พ.ศ. 1899|tk|1356|tl|1356|tly|1356|tr|1356|tt|1356 ел|uk|1356|ur|1356ء|uz|1356|vec|1356|vi|1356|war|1356|wuu|1356年|xmf|1356|zea|1356|zh|1356年|zh_min_nan|1356 nî|zh_yue|1356年|qid=Q6130|lt=1356}}), Enchū completed the {{ill|Suwa Daimyōjin Ekotoba|fa|سابقه مصور زیارتگاه سووا|id|Suwa Daimyōjin Ekotoba|ja|諏方大明神画詞|qid=Q11631818|lt=Suwa Daimyōjin Ekotoba}}, which bore a postscript by Takauji. This work spread Suwa faith throughout various strata of society, including the court nobility. As part of Takauji’s initiative to establish a national network of {{ill|Ankoku-ji|ja|安国寺利生塔|zh|安國寺利生塔|qid=Q10158536|lt=Ankokuji temples}}, Enchū founded {{ill|Ankokoji (Chino City)|ja|安国寺 (茅野市)|qid=Q20043040}} near the Suwa Upper Shrine with Musō Soseki as its founding abbot.

Enchū also inherited knowledge of {{ill|Falconry|ar|صقارة|ast|Cetrería|ba|Ыласын менән һунар итеү|bg|Соколарство|br|Falc'hunerezh|bs|Sokolarstvo|ca|Falconeria|cs|Sokolnictví|da|Falkejagt|de|Falknerei|eo|Falkado|es|Cetrería|eu|Falkoneria|fa|بازداری|fi|Haukkametsästys|fr|Fauconnerie|fy|Falkejacht|gl|Falcoaría|he|בזיירות|hi|श्येनपालन|hr|Sokolarstvo|hu|Solymászat|ia|Falconeria|id|Falconry|is|Fálkaveiðar|it|Falconeria|ja|鷹狩|jv|Falconry|ka|ბაზი (ფრინველი)|kn|ಗಿಡುಗ ಸಾಕಣೆ|ko|매사냥|ky|Алгыр куштар|la|Falconaria|lt|Sakalininkystė|lv|Medības ar plēsējputniem|mk|Соколарство|my|သိမ်းတိုက်ခြင်း|nl|Valkerij|no|Falkoneri|pl|Sokolnictwo|pnb|باز داری|pt|Falcoaria|ro|Falconerie|ru|Соколиная охота|scn|Falcunirìa|sh|Sokolarstvo|sk|Sokoliarstvo|sr|Соколарство|sv|Falkenering|ta|வல்லூறு வளர்ப்பு|tg|Боздорӣ|tr|Doğancılık|uk|Соколине полювання|vi|Nuôi chim săn|wa|Fåkinreye|wuu|鷹獵|zh|鹰猎|zh_yue|鷹獵|qid=Q211011}} from the {{ill|Q11536451|ja|根津氏|qid=Q11536451}}, a branch of the Suwa clan, as recorded in the {{ill|Kami Clan Genealogy|ja|神氏系図}}. This expertise was passed down among the heads of the Kyoto Suwa clan, and in Enchū also excelled in waka and renga poetry, with works selected for the {{ill|Shinsenzai Wakashū|bcl|Shinsenzai Wakashū|de|Shinsenzai-wakashū|fr|Shinsenzai wakashū|it|Shinsenzai Wakashū|ja|新千載和歌集|zh|新千載和歌集|qid=Q1143262|lt=Shin Chokusenshū}}, {{ill|Shingoshūi Wakashū|de|Shingoshūi-wakashū|fr|Shingoshūi wakashū|it|Shingoshūi Wakashū|ja|新後拾遺和歌集|qid=Q288358|lt=Shin Goshūishū}}, and {{ill|Tsukubashū|fa|تسوکوباشو|fr|Tsukubashū|it|Tsukubashū|ja|菟玖波集|qid=Q3007417|lt=Tsukubashū}}.<ref>[https://www.ro-da.jp/shinshu-dcommons/museum_history/03OD0624101600] "Kami Clan Genealogy: Copy of Maeda Manuscript"</ref>
